headlines.text: Oil crosses $100 a barrel for the first time in months as the U.S. destroys five Iranian tankers and a Tehran-backed group torches Saudi oil facilities.
Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures hold roughly steady Wednesday as traders weigh the oil spike against a still-uncertain Fed rate path.
The 10-year Treasury yield tops 4.81%, its highest since November 2023, as surging oil prices reignite inflation anxiety.
Fed Governor Waller says he'd lean toward holding rates steady on Sept. 16, but a hot August CPI print due Friday could tip him toward a hike.
Amgen sinks 9% and Novartis drops 14% after Novartis' pelacarsen failed a pivotal cardiovascular trial, clouding the whole Lp(a)-lowering drug class.
Oracle's fiscal Q1 report Thursday looms as a make-or-break test for the AI trade, with options pricing in an 11% stock swing.
